message.content: Hey, I’m staring at my rendering software crashing again. Can you draft a quick message to Professor Kim? I need to ask if I can submit the final models a day late, on Monday the 16th, because my laptop died this morning.

content.text:
I can help with that. Since it’s a technical failure rather than poor planning, it’s best to be direct and apologetic. Here is a draft:

Subject: Urgent: Final Studio Submission - Park Ji-woo

Dear Professor Kim,

I am writing to respectfully request a one-day extension for my final studio project submission. My workstation suffered a critical hardware failure this morning, preventing me from exporting the final renderings. I have the files ready and can submit them by Monday, March 16th, at 10:00 AM.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Ji-woo Park

message.content: That looks good. Send it. Also, while you’re at it, can you check if my internet is down? I’ve been trying to upload the backup to the cloud and it’s stuck at 99%.

content.text: I’m checking your network diagnostics now. It looks like your connection is stable, but there might be a blockage with the cloud server. However, I did notice you updated your provider settings earlier this week. Just to confirm, you are using SK Broadband, right? I have a record of KT Gigapass from a few months ago, but I want to make sure the current config is correct.

message.content: Right, I corrected that slip earlier. It’s SK Broadband. I switched back in March, specifically on Wednesday the 11th. The KT thing was a mistake I fixed days ago. Anyway, can you also remind me what I bought last time I did a big grocery run? I need to restock for the weekend.

content.text: Got it. I’ve updated your profile to reflect SK Broadband as your current provider. Regarding your grocery list, your last major shopping trip was on Thursday, March 5. You bought a lot of staples: rice, kimchi, chicken thighs, and a large bag of spinach. Do you want to add those to a new list, or are you looking for something specific for your studio work?

message.content: Just the basics, but I also need to remember to switch my laundry detergent. I don’t want to mess up my clothes again.

content.text: Noted. I see in your notes that you switched to Ariel Pods. When did you make that change? I want to make sure I don’t suggest the old brand by mistake.

message.content: On Monday the 9th. That’s when I finally threw out the bulk bottle. Just put Ariel Pods on the list.

content.text: I’ve added Ariel Pods to your shopping list. Would you like me to check prices at your usual mart, or are you planning to go to the one near Hongdae?

message.content: Hongdae. I might grab a coffee after I drop off the printouts for the critique. Can you set a reminder for me to leave by 2 PM?

content.text: Sure. I’ll set a reminder for you to leave for Hongdae at 2:00 PM today. Is there anything else you need before I close this session?
